rows.text: The assessment of climate-related risk scenarios is 1 • Risk Identification • Identification of climate-related risks within EGCO's operational and compliance risks • Identification of physical and transition risks relevant to EGCO's business 2 • Corporate Risks Assessment • Risks are assessed according to the company's Risk Management Manual where climate-related risks are incorporated into corporate risk assessment processes • Key Risk Indicators are established for risk management purposes 3 • Evaluation of Business Impacts • Assessment of physical and transition risks using scenario analyses and climate-related data projections.
rows.source_sentence: The assessment of climate-related risk scenarios is 1 • Risk Identification • Identification of climate-related risks within EGCO's operational and compliance risks • Identification of physical and transition risks relevant to EGCO's business 2 • Corporate Risks Assessment • Risks are assessed according to the company's Risk Management Manual where climate-related risks are incorporated into corporate risk assessment processes • Key Risk Indicators are established for risk management purposes 3 • Evaluation of Business Impacts • Assessment of physical and transition risks using scenario analyses and climate-related data projections.
